resources.string: Choose a workspace from your PC, including workspaces with no chats. Creating a chat does not send a message or start a model run.
No PC workspaces are loaded. Refresh the list, or create a workspace on your PC first.
Up to %1$d UTF-8 bytes. Leading and trailing whitespace will be trimmed.
Use valid text within %1$d UTF-8 bytes. The previous valid title is still shown; edit it to continue.
Enter a title that is not blank.
Archive only the named chat on your PC. Its history is preserved; this is not deletion. Archiving does not stop running work.
This chat is busy. Wait for its work to finish before archiving; this dialog cannot stop it.
This chat is no longer in the loaded PC list. Cancel and refresh the sidebar before trying again.
Finish or clear the current draft before starting a new chat or archiving the current chat. This dialog never discards your draft.

On your PC, open Settings → General → Phone settings → Paired phones → Enable chat management. Confirm the phone fingerprint in the native PC app. This phone cannot grant permission, and no re-pairing is needed.
Checking chat-management permission on your PC…
Chat management or the workspace list is unavailable. Check the connection, permission and app compatibility on your PC.
Keep this app visible and reconnect to your PC before managing chats.
A PC request is in progress. Wait before making another change.
If a result is uncertain, check the chat on your PC before trying again. Changes are never resent automatically.
